direction: Natural matte gouache and colored pencil, diffuse daylight, muted alpine colors. No sun or moon.

day.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Edit target: the supplied 1536x1024 alpine 404 illustration. Repaint this composition as a restrained, traditional gouache and colored-pencil illustration on lightly textured paper. It should feel like a real illustrator's travel sketchbook painting, observed and imperfect, with confident broad brush shapes and selective detail. Keep the same landscape framing and every important subject in its existing place and scale so the website's text overlays still align.

Remove the sun entirely and paint uninterrupted pale blue-gray sky in its place. No visible sun, moon, luminous disk or halo anywhere. Keep the central upper half of the sky quiet and very pale for live HTML text. Few broad, understated overcast cloud washes, not rows of decorative peach clouds.

The CURRENT glossy fantasy rendering is the problem. Change the actual drawing and paint treatment, rather than just adding a texture filter. Matte, soft-edged gouache shapes, irregular pencil contours, visible dry-brush strokes, some unfinished edges, subtle paper showing through. Muted real alpine colors: sage and lichen greens, dusty violet clothing, warm stone grays, oatmeal parchment, washed blue distant mountains, natural weathered brown wood. Diffuse late-afternoon daylight. No cinematic orange rim lights, no bloom, no HDR contrast, no glossy 3D surfaces or airbrushed fur. Reduce over-rendering and repeated ornamental detail: grass and wildflowers grow in irregular sparse patches, broad meadow areas can remain simple; mountains have believable broken silhouettes and subtle atmospheric depth, not identical decorative peaks. The path is worn dirt with uneven stones, not a glowing golden carpet.

Melo stays sitting on the rock lower-left reading the unfolded map with the same puzzled expression. Preserve the purple fox identity, big ears, cream face, forehead sun-shaped marking as a small painted gold mark rather than a light source, purple hoodie, backpack, cream-tipped tail. Draw Melo with soft matte painted fur masses, a few pencil fur strokes, small restrained eye highlights, natural cloth folds. The floating white-and-brass robot remains beside Melo at the same size and position, matte ceramic with a little amber eye expression and simple thin brass ring. Lantern stays in its place but daylight glow is very weak. Exactly three blank wooden signboards stay in the SAME positions with the SAME bounds and shapes; their clear label areas remain warm light wood with simple uneven grain, less tidy decorative moss. Preserve x/y registration of sign faces, seated character, robot, lantern, rock, map and trail.

A calm, believable little alpine adventure with some drawing personality. Full bleed to the edges, no frame. No typography, lettering, numbers, labels, UI, buttons, watermark or decorative sparkles. Preserve 1536x1024 output.

night.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Edit target: this finished natural gouache alpine illustration. Make the matching nighttime version by changing ONLY the pigment colors and lighting. Maintain precisely the same 1536x1024 composition, every contour, silhouette, brush stroke, paper grain, cloud shape, mountain edge, grass patch, flower, stone and board edge at the exact same coordinates. Keep Melo's identity, puzzled expression, pose, map, rock, tail and backpack unchanged; keep the robot, lantern and signpost exactly registered. Do not redraw the image.

A quiet alpine night in muted smoky slate blue and gray-violet, with soft deep blue-gray sky and a few small faint pinprick stars. No moon, no sun, no bright disk, no halo, no starbursts or sparkle icons. Upper central sky remains calm and dark for pale live webpage text. Maintain the hand-painted gouache and colored-pencil feel, matte surfaces, irregular edges and paper texture. The warm lantern paints a small understated amber wash on the existing nearby rock and dirt; robot eyes are a soft amber, not neon. Leave the forehead sun-shaped identity marking as painted ochre, no glow. Signboards stay natural mid-light weathered timber so dark live labels stay readable; preserve all their exact boundaries and face shapes. Forests and mountains keep soft atmospheric separation and readable painted detail in the shadows. No cinematic rim lighting, no bloom, no saturated purple or orange color grading, no glossy 3D look, no added decorative objects.
No text, labels, numerals, UI or buttons. Same scene at night, not a new illustration.
